scorecard.step: 1. Page one and who leads it
scorecard.key_number: 5 of 10 controlled (target 6); main home page #1; old domain #2
scorecard.why: The home page leads, but the old domain's login copy sits at #2 and control is 1 short of the target.

scorecard.key_number: panel present; 1 conflicting row; no profiles row
scorecard.why: Google shows founded 2016; the company was founded in 2018, and the panel lists none of the 8 official profiles.
6 trust questions have no owned answer while a refund complaint thread sits at #7 on page one.

scorecard.key_number: negative result at #7; lowest page-one rating 3.6
scorecard.why: A refund complaint ranks #7 and Trustpilot shows 3.6 of 5; G2 and Capterra are healthy.

scorecard.key_number: 2 facts in conflict; markup lacks foundingDate, founder, address, legalName, logo, description, sameAs
scorecard.why: The old name is still the site name in the WebSite markup and og:site_name, so Google shows it; the founding year differs on the panel, Crunchbase and the AI Overview.
Brand-alone searches click through at 38.8%, and 'example booking login' sends 420 of 610 clicks to the home page instead of /login/.

fixes.do: Change the WebSite markup name and og:site_name on the home page to 'Example Booking', add alternateName 'ExampleBooking', and keep the title and H1 using the same name.
fixes.evidence: WebSite name 'Example Slots', og:site_name 'Example Slots', shown site name 'Example Slots'
fixes.recheck: the site name on the #1 result after Google recrawls the home page

fixes.do: Link 'Log in' from the header of every page with that exact anchor, title the login page 'Log in to Example Booking', and keep it indexable. Give /contact/ and /signup/ the same clear titles and header or footer links.
fixes.evidence: sitelinks: Pricing, Online booking page, Book a demo, Booking software for salons; 'example booking login' sends 420 of 610 clicks to / and 190 to /login/; 'example booking login' and 'example slots login' have no owned answer on /login/
fixes.recheck: a login sitelink under #1, and the click share of /login/ for 'example booking login' in Search Console

fixes.do: Redirect every page on exampleslots.example to its match on www.example.com (login to /login/, help pages to their help articles) with 301s, and publish a short 'Example Slots is now Example Booking' page on the main site.
fixes.evidence: the old domain holds #2 and #14 on Google and #2 and #5 on Bing; 'What happened to Example Slots?' is a People Also Ask question with no owned answer
fixes.recheck: the old domain gone from page one; the main login page in its place

knowledge_panel_plan.title: Example Booking
knowledge_panel_plan.subtitle: Software company
steps: Search 'Example Booking' signed in to the Google Account that manages the Search Console property, and click 'Claim this knowledge panel' at the bottom of the panel. Sign in to Search Console or the YouTube channel when Google asks.
If the claim button isn't there yet, use Feedback on the Founded row now and check back for the button later.
After verification, use Suggest edits on the Founded row only, with the About page, the LinkedIn page and the corrected Crunchbase profile as supporting URLs.
Don't ask for a new subtitle or description: Google sets those itself. The profiles row comes from consistent sameAs links and profiles that link back.
